description: A `config.style` block reaches Vega whole. `stripAndRedirectConfig` deletes the Vega-Lite-only mark properties from `config.mark` — `if (config.mark) { for (const prop of VL_ONLY_MARK_CONFIG_PROPERTIES) delete config.mark[prop]; }` — and from each `config[markType]` inside `for (const markType of MARK_STYLES)`, and from nowhere else; a named style is never walked, and the redirection that follows only merges a mark-type block *into* it, `{...propConfig, ...config.style[toProp ?? prop]}`. Filtered as though it were a mark config, a style block arrived at the renderer without every word on that list, so a theme that said how a named style treats an unplaceable value, or what colour it draws in, was answered with nothing. The first row names a style that carries a colour and an `invalid` rule, which have to survive in `config.style` for Vega to apply them; the second declares a style no mark names, carrying the rest of the list, because a theme may define styles a given chart never asks for and they still belong in the block that goes out. The third row must not change: `config.mark` and `config.bar` lose exactly these properties on the way out, `config.bar` becoming the `bar` style as it goes, so the block a bar is drawn from keeps only the words Vega knows. Both marks are drawn from data with nothing unplaceable in it, so the `invalid` rule is pinned as configuration rather than as a redrawn scene.
